35.59296,-82.43619: Warren Wilson College. Founded in 1894 by the Presbyterian Church as Asheville Farm School. A four-year college since 1966. 1 1/2 mi. E.
35.91748,-82.29976: Yancey Collegiate Institute. A Baptist preparatory school, 1901-1926. Two of the buildings later used by public schools. 1/2 mile northeast.
